title: [bug] Icons fail to work under Ubuntu 22.04.1 LTS & Tauri 1.1.1

labels.name: status: needs triage
labels.description: This issue needs to triage, applied to new issues

body:
### Describe the bug

A placeholder icon (the gear icon below) shows up instead of the given ones. This happens with a *fresh* new [create-tauri-app](https://github.com/tauri-apps/create-tauri-app) application.

![screenshot](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/37125/191573240-40e448c1-7964-4d5e-a01e-d01b08e0324a.png)

AFAICT, this wasn't happening with Tauri 1.0.x

### Reproduction

The exact steps are shown below, together with part of the output where applicable.

### Expected behavior

The vanilla icons under `tauri-app/src-tauri/icons` to appear, e.g.,

![128x128@2x](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/37125/191574240-d2196844-81b3-4173-8397-5a43077d38d0.png)

### Additional context

EDIT 2: the built executable (`./src-tauri/target/release/tauri-app`) also doesn't show the correct icon. [build-deb.zip](https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/files/9619259/build-deb.zip) contains the generated `.deb` file if that's useful.
